user.title: Set up NZ Parcel Tracker
user.description: Tracking needs no account or postal code — the hub is created right away. Add parcels afterwards via the integration options or the `nz_parcel_tracker.track_parcel` service.

abort.already_configured: NZ Parcel Tracker is already set up.

add_parcel.title: Add a parcel
add_parcel.description: Choose the courier the parcel is with, then enter its tracking number (from the shipping confirmation or the missed-delivery card). For Post Haste, enter the customer number and the consignment ID separated by a space, for example 2020119 DESX0026044.

data_description.tracking_code: Just the number, not a link.

remove_parcels.title: Remove parcels
remove_parcels.description: Select the parcels to stop tracking.

error.invalid_tracking_code: That does not look like a tracking number for the chosen courier. Check it is just the number, with letters and numbers only.
error.tracking_code_is_link: That looks like a web address. Enter just the tracking number, not the link.
error.already_tracked: That parcel is already being tracked.

track_parcel.name: Track parcel
track_parcel.description: Start tracking a parcel by its tracking code.

tracking_code.name: Tracking code
tracking_code.description: The tracking code (the number only, not a link).

carrier.name: Courier
carrier.description: Which courier the parcel is with.

untrack_parcel.name: Untrack parcel
untrack_parcel.description: Stop tracking a parcel by its tracking code.

tracking_code.name: Tracking code
tracking_code.description: The tracking code to stop tracking.

trigger_type.parcel_delivery_time_changed: A parcel's expected delivery time changed
